description: Defines a mutex class and related synchronization primitives for the quiche project, including lock acquisition and release methods, and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: QuicheMutex
classes.description: A non-reentrant mutex class with methods for locking, unlocking, and asserting lock status.

classes.name: QuicheReaderMutexLock
classes.description: Helper class for acquiring shared lock on a QuicheMutex within scope.

classes.name: QuicheWriterMutexLock
classes.description: Helper class for acquiring exclusive lock on a QuicheMutex within scope.

classes.name: QuicheNotification
classes.description: Class for thread notification of a single event occurrence.

methods.name: WriterLock
methods.description: Acquire the mutex exclusively, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: WriterUnlock
methods.description: Release the exclusive lock on the mutex.

methods.name: ReaderLock
methods.description: Acquire a shared lock on the mutex.

methods.name: ReaderUnlock
methods.description: Release a shared lock on the mutex.

methods.name: AssertReaderHeld
methods.description: Assert that the current thread holds at least a shared lock.

methods.name: QuicheReaderMutexLock
methods.description: Constructor that acquires a shared lock on the provided mutex.

methods.name: QuicheReaderMutexLock~
methods.description: Destructor that releases the shared lock.

methods.name: QuicheWriterMutexLock
methods.description: Constructor that acquires an exclusive lock on the provided mutex.

methods.name: QuicheWriterMutexLock~
methods.description: Destructor that releases the exclusive lock.

methods.name: QuicheNotification
methods.description: Class for thread notification, with methods to check notification status, notify, and wait.
